# deps: tools: up esbuild to v0.14.40

Pin `esbuild` at v0.14.40 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-297]] (v0.14.39). `esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the toolset; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.14.40 tag](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.14.40).
